folders.label: Chords

folders.label: All 12 keys

folders.label: Bass lines

folders.label: Combo loops
folders.what: Piano, walking bass and ride cymbal together, one loop per progression.

folders.label: Genre loops
folders.what: Every progression as a lofi, neo soul, trap soul or deep house loop: chords, bass and drums as separate files, plus the full loop.
